subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration and POC next steps (ACME Analytics)
messages:
From: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sales discovery call recap — Redwood integration (ACME Analytics)

Thanks for the call earlier, Marissa — good discussion. Quick recap from our side to make sure we're aligned: 

- Pain points:
  - High latency on our interactive analytics UI when using embeddings for semantic search across 100M+ docs. Peak p95 latency is ~1.2s which is too slow for customers.
  - Current reranking pipeline is expensive; we need better embeddings + rerank strategy to reduce tokens and compute cost.
  - Need structured outputs from the model for downstream ingestion (JSON with typed fields).

- Goals:
  - Reduce 95th percentile search latency to <350ms for user-facing queries.
  - Cut per-query cost on rerank stage by at least 40% while improving relevance.
  - Proof-of-concept using streaming for conversational UI and function calling to surface live system data.

Next actions we talked about: 1) POC scope (embeddings + rerank, streaming chat integration), 2) security questions (SOC2 evidence), 3) preliminary pricing for a dedicated pool.

Could you share the integration playbook and a suggested timeline for a 4-week POC? I'll loop in Lina (engineer) on our side for technical alignment.

--
Carlos
Head of Search, ACME Analytics
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Lina Huang <lina.huang@acmeanalytics.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sales discovery call recap — Redwood integration (ACME Analytics)

Hi Carlos — thanks for the clear summary and for looping Lina in. Confirming alignment and adding detail on how we propose to approach the POC: 

1) Scope (4 weeks, joint runbook)
   - Week 0: Kickoff + access (API keys, test dataset upload)
   - Weeks 1-2: Embeddings + rerank experiments (compare dense embeddings + lightweight re-rank vs current pipeline).
   - Week 3: Streaming chat integration + function calling to fetch live metadata from your service. We'll demo structured JSON outputs for ingestion.
   - Week 4: Latency/cost tuning, quantization recommendations, and an ops handoff with SDK snippets.

2) Technical notes (what to expect)
   - SDK: minor client SDK update to enable streaming + chunked responses (we'll provide snippets).
   - Function calling: Redwood supports structured function-tool calls; we'll map your system endpoints so the model can surface live values.
   - Streaming + structured outputs: we can stream tokens while emitting final JSON blocks for downstream ingestion.
   - Embeddings/reranking: we'll test model/quantization combos and a small reranker model to reduce tokenized re-ranking cost.

3) Security/compliance: attaching our SOC2 attestation and an integration playbook that covers data handling and network options (VPC/private deploy if required).

Attachments: redwood-integration-playbook.pdf, SOC2-Attestation.pdf

Next steps: 
- Carlos/Lina: confirm POC dataset (sample size, index shape) and the person who will be the technical owner on your side.
- Redwood (Neha + Dev): we'll propose available start dates next week and send a meeting invite for kickoff.

I'll follow up with a proposed calendar and the POC runbook.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Huang <lina.huang@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T17:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sales discovery call recap — Redwood integration (ACME Analytics)

Appreciate the detailed plan, Marissa. A few clarifications from Lina: 

- Dataset: we'll share a 5k query sample + index dump (anonymized) by EOD Monday.
- Technical owner: Lina will be primary for integration; I'm copied.
- SOC2: thanks, we'll review the attestation and may follow up with a short questionnaire.

Can you also include a rough estimate for dedicated pool sizing for a 4-week POC and an indicative cost delta vs hosted API? That will help procurement move the internal request faster.

Thanks,
Carlos
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
